sampling_strategy.default_take: entrypoints, trust/data/integration/business surfaces, highest complexity files, deployment/config files, and nearby tests
sampling_strategy.large_repo_note: Use hotspots as a queue for specialist review, not as final findings.

metadata.policy: static-first; no dependency install; no submitted code execution; no submitted tests; no network calls

orchestration_guidance.coverage_expectation: Record reviewed, sampled, skipped, and unknown surfaces in final findings.
